architecture.intent: M04 owns whole-document lifecycle, safe serialization and formal-save orchestration; existing WORK S1 owns revision/history rules. No second authoritative design state.
architecture.system_context: Desktop Editor requests document operations. HOST validates/encodes; application owner reserves identity and applies S1 plans. IO adapter exclusively owns transaction journal. Material owner supplies immutable, versioned resolution evidence.
architecture.hexagonal: UI → Tauri closed commands → DispatchHost DocumentOwner input port → existing WORK DocumentSession. DocumentOwner → codec interface / target-selection interface / material-resolution interface / FileCommitPort. Infrastructure implements external interfaces. Pure WORK never calls IO/Tauri.
architecture.dependency_map: M03 Design owner facade → M04 DocumentOwner (one session registry) → WORK S1; M04 DocumentOwner → HOST document_codec; Tauri target adapter → existing FileCommitPort; material resolver adapter → explicit owner-supplied snapshot. M05 retention consumes roots; it is not the resolver.

ownership.DocumentOwner: One registry entry per (project UUID, document UUID); one S1 session, generation and target binding. Owns reservations, plans and proof cache; not a second copy of content.
ownership.M03: Facade only, M04 single DocumentOwner registry/session. All imported candidates/clear/merge/undo use common MutationReceipt.
ownership.IO: Lease, journal, old/new files, commit transaction IDs.
ownership.material_owner: Authoritative asset/version identity and binding target evidence. Unavailable provider fails closed.
ownership.UI: Projection/selection only; no dirty flag or label-derived authority.

architecture.mutation: Prepared validated content committed by current owner using S1 prepare/commit or undo, with expected revision. No field setter or session reconstruction to clear dirty/health.
architecture.transaction: Open: resolve trusted selection → reserve target → acquire lease → read → guarded decode → complete material/binding resolution → revalidate generation → fresh session install. Edit/clear: capture → candidate → resolve → revalidate → single S1 commit. Save: capture → encode → reserve → replace_checked → verify receipt → ACK captured revision+semantic.

formats: DesignJsonV1 (C1 design JSON only); no implicit XML/JSON conversion
output_serialization.inspection: Guarded parse returns CodecInspection {format, lossless_tree, semantic_profile, semantic_digest, unresolved_references, unsupported_projection_paths}. It cannot construct trusted DocumentContent until resolver has returned complete evidence.
output_serialization.xml_ast: Canonical payload is compact UTF8 JSON tagged ["M04-EssXmlV1-payload-v1",element]. element=["e",name,[[attr,value] sorted UTF8 attr-name bytes],ordered children]; text=["t",value], comment=["c",value]. Names and values remain strings. This internal payload is not disk XML.

xml_output.declaration: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> followed by LF; exactly one root; final LF; no BOM or indentation insertion.
xml_output.elements: Emit attributes sorted by UTF8 name bytes, double quotes. Empty child list emits <name/>; otherwise explicit open/children/close. Preserve ordered decoded Text/Comment nodes including whitespace; no numeric/boolean coercion.
xml_output.escapes:
Text: &→&, <→<, >→>, CR→. Attribute: additionally double quote→", TAB→	, LF→
, CR→. Other valid XML1.0 characters literal UTF8. Reject invalid XML1.0 scalars, names, comments containing -- or ending -, namespaced names and unsupported AST variants.
xml_output.roundtrip: decode(encode(tree)) equals normalized decoded tree including comments/text/empty attribute values. XML lexical quote choice, entity spelling and original declaration bytes need not match.
xml_output.allocation: Counting writer checks output_bytes before extending destination; limit16MiB inclusive. No file IO until complete valid bytes and digest exist. Reject output-invalid AST before write. Encoder re-runs structural/resource validation and semantic consistency.

output_serialization.json_output: Use separately adopted C1 serializer with full optional fields and exact decimal rules. No Tauri typed DTO before inner raw design_json guard. C1 output cap remains independent. M04 validates stored semantic profile/digest by recomputation before encode.

limits.counting: xml_nodes counts root/element/text/comment nodes in lexical order, including whitespace text; excludes declaration, attribute names/values. depth increments only nested child element, text/comment inherit containing element depth. Attribute count checked independently per element before values. Each decoded attribute/text/comment string checked individually; XML attributes remain strings, no JSON number-token rule.
limits.error_shape: CodecError::ResourceLimit {path:XML path,token:input_bytes|depth|xml_nodes|string_bytes|attributes}; input_bytes path=/; child element pointers use /tag[index] 1-based among same-tag siblings; text/comment use /text()[index] or /comment()[index]; attribute uses /@name. No truncated path equality assertions.
precedence: strict UTF8/no BOM per proposed encoding profile
token grammar; actual DOCTYPE/namespace/general entity/PI feature reject before expansion or full AST allocation
on start-element: depth -> xml_nodes -> attributes count -> decoded attribute strings in source order
on text/comment: xml_nodes -> decoded string bytes
after guarded full parse: format/version/required unique sections
only after representation validation: semantic projection, trusted dependency validation, owner install
limits.security: DTD/external/general entities and namespace/PI unsupported profile. Detect tokens using lexer context, never substring-scan comments/text. A comment containing literal <!DOCTYPE is inert text if otherwise legal. No network/filesystem callbacks in codec.
limits.fixture_policy: Resource recipes must expand exact input and verify counts before product call; wrong recipe or unavailable dependency is fixture failure, never valid RED. Unknown extra payload element is preserved/unsupported view per unapproved R2 profile, not silently discarded.

output_serialization.semantic_xml: Use ordered typed XML AST above; omit comments and only exact volatile paths from s2-canonical-profile. Whitespace rule from frozen profile applies. Hash compact UTF8 JSON ["M04-EssXmlV1-semantic-v1",semantic_element] with same escaped JSON string policy as joint profile. Attribute order sorted, child order significant; XML "1" and "1.0" remain distinct.
output_serialization.semantic_design: SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 per common contract; never old untagged/mismatched profile; M07 ACK original semantic not recovery raw fingerprint.
output_serialization.output_boundaries: Typed AST valid on input can exceed output cap because escaping expands bytes. Fixture expands encoder-independent expected XML bytes at max-1/max/max+1 and verifies length before product call. Error output_bytes at /; precommit state/file/history/baselines unchanged.

material_binding.request: ReferenceRequest {source_path, kind:asset|binding, opaque_id, pinned_digest?:lowerhex64, target_id?:string}. IDs nonempty UTF8 ≤256bytes, no NUL; case-sensitive. Never interpret labels, free text or path as an asset ID without explicit registry mapping.
material_binding.recognition: EssXmlV1 only /eluslotScene/architecture/eluslotArch/nodes/node/assetRefs/assetRef text is recognized legacy asset reference. Preserve exact original text; resolver registry must explicitly map it. No trim/coercion. Unknown element/attribute whose semantics are not in an adopted projector sets unsupported_projection_paths; no trusted mutation/save/clear until complete projector available. DesignJsonV1 binding/reference extraction belongs to adopted C1+H2 projector; no recursive guessing of props strings.
material_binding.response: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
material_binding.binding_policy: Valid requires target in candidate entity-ID set or explicit external catalog proof. Missing internal target becomes Pending only if original authored binding explicitly declares pending; otherwise InvalidDependency. Invalid is preserved for inspection only and blocks trusted install/save/clear; no conversion to valid by dropping binding. Pending bindings retained, block execute/build capabilities; edit/save permitted only with Complete resolution and all asset versions pinned.
material_binding.freshness: ResolutionSnapshot generation/raw digest checked atomically by M05 pin under catalog lease; validate_pin before document commit, exact Context+versions. No validate(snapshot) root-proof shortcut. Missing root providers retain pins independently.
material_binding.availability: M05-S1 is retention policy, not catalog or physical pin implementation. Proposed production integration uses fail-closed Unavailable resolver until separately approved provider/pinning implementation accepted. Reference-free documents use locally verified Complete empty snapshot only if projector proved no reference-bearing/unknown content; never [] for unexamined material.
material_binding.out_of_scope: No asset copy/delete/GC, external download, automatic version upgrade, repair, actual merge or M05 catalog implementation. New resolver signature is a proposed application output port, not an already existing Port.

clear_policy.prepare: Current owner +Healthy+S1 editable+expected revision. Decode captured whole document; require Complete projection and resolution. Return server-held ClearPlan {opaque plan_id,owner_generation,session_uuid,revision,before_semantic,format,policy_version,counts,paths,expires_at}. TTL60seconds monotonic; proposed cap32plans/session, reject capacity without eviction.
clear_policy.ess_policy: Policy ESS-CLEAR-v1 accepts closed scaffold: root meta/work/architecture/design; meta preserved except exact volatile exclusions; work contains board, board contains task only; architecture contains eluslotArch with meta/nodes/edges; nodes only node, edges only edge; design contains meta/nodes/selection/product_pass, nodes only node. Unknown business child/attribute anywhere in cleared containers or unsupported nested node shape blocks clear with UnsupportedProjection; no silent dropping. Exact allowed attributes are the frozen sample map; sample is a deliberately restricted clear profile, not claim of complete ESS schema.
clear_policy.ess_result: Remove every work/board/task, every architecture node/edge, every design node, empty design selection text. Preserve empty required containers and all metadata/root format identity; product_pass must false. This clears design Form too for ESS aggregate; no insertion of synthetic defaults. Cleared nodes carry their bindings/assets out of live projection; Undo retains complete before-content and pinned versions. No filesystem deletion.
clear_policy.design_policy: DESIGN-CLEAR-v1: C1/H2 adopted validator must identify exactly one root Form. Keep its id/type/parent, geometry and all supported props; remove all other nodes, relations/bindings owned by removed nodes, set selection to root Form ID if field present (otherwise remain absent), keep meta optional fields exactly including 0/false/empty guides. Form-owned bindings remain and must resolve. Ambiguous root/multiple Forms/unknown relationship ownership rejects clear. No arbitrary unknown props deletion.
clear_policy.confirm: Revalidate owner/generation/TTL/revision/semantic/proof; Candidate pin before one Clear commit; live/Undo/Redo transfer after. AppliedRetentionDeferred if transfer failed, actual revision retained; NoChange noUndo.
clear_policy.failure: Any error before S1 commit preserves content/revision/history/formal and snapshot baselines. Clear does not save; dirty reflects semantic delta. Undo uses existing S1 once and restores assets/bindings/metadata. No domain recovery setter.
clear_policy.lifecycle: Close/switch/discard cancels plans, revokes writer and Viewer capabilities. Completed save proofs remain target-scoped evidence even if session detached. Late clear confirmation never installs into replacement generation.

save_health_reopen.capture: Immutable S1 capture plus project/document/session/generation/request/target identity/previous raw digest/exact encoded bytes/semantic profile+digest. Freeze these before IO; no UI-provided digest or payload at save.
save_health_reopen.lease: Opaque server-selected target proof; canonical path from trusted native selection under authorized project, plus stable file/parent identity and aliases tested by target adapter. String path equality is insufficient. Existing file lease held from open through detach; SaveAs uses distinct lease and expected absent target (previous=None); existing target SaveAs rejected until separate overwrite contract.

reserve.FormalWriteReservation: blocks same-owner content edits until matching IO completion; read diagnostics allowed.
reserve.RecoveryAttemptReservation: one recovery attempt; after immutable capture+pin, live healthy owner may edit. Never reuse formal saving state for whole recovery copy pipeline.
reserve.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.

save_health_reopen.receipt: Capture→Save pin→verified file receipt→M05 formal-root TransferReceipt→ACK captured revision+semantic. Transfer failed after commit: CommittedAckDeferred stage RetentionTransfer, keep Held+file proof; no retry rewrite or snapshot ACK.
save_health_reopen.outcomes: Saved {request_id,captured_revision,live_revision,dirty,proof_id}; CommittedAckDeferred {proof_id,reason:Detached|OwnerChanged|AckRejected}; FailedBeforeCommit {error}; RecoveryBlocked {proof_id,error}. committed/deferred cannot be reported ordinary unchanged failure or automatically retried.
save_health_reopen.health: IO RecoveryRequired or receipt mismatch→RecoveryBlocked retaining error/proof and target identity through detach. Other IO errors preserve exact details; release only matching reservation. No automatic clear on acquire success, timeout or new window. Runtime-only registry cannot claim durable uncertain-proof tracking.
save_health_reopen.reopen: RO-A explicit fresh open acquires existing FileCommitPort lease; adapter already inspects journal and rejects unresolved/invalid/mismatched journal. Acquire may create lock sidecar. Read/decode/resolve/native owner validate before install new S1 session baseline; no old ACK replay. In-runtime uncertain target remains denied across reopen. Across restart rely only on adapter journal gates; receipt-mismatch not durably attested, so complete recovery certification excluded.
save_health_reopen.clear_health_policy: No public unblock command in this slice. Diagnostic export and detach allowed; repair/attested unblock requires separately approved IO-owned recovery Port/transaction. Do not implement clear-health by rebuilding session. An explicit repair may be future work; user-facing blocked status includes target evidence.
save_health_reopen.leave: Server plan TTL60s captures owner/generation/revision. Save choice proceeds only Saved with current captured revision and no newer dirty revision; deferred/blocked/stale remains open. Discard detaches current generation after exact confirmation; Cancel changes nothing. Successful project switch revokes all matching capabilities; failure preserves current owner.
save_health_reopen.dependencies: Alias-safe native selection/identity is not established by IO raw path API. Reuse only separately adopted+accepted M01-S3 target seam; absent provider returns DependencyNotReady before acquire. This package approves integration contract, not implementation of M01-S3 or IO recovery.

dto_errors.shape: DocumentError {code,stage,path?,reason,request_id?,details}; no ambiguous boolean success+error. Paths XML per frozen resource contract, JSON RFC6901; infrastructure absolute path details only authorized diagnostic view.
dto_errors.precedence: Tauri trusted caller/role → outer closed DTO and size → project/session/generation → replay key identity → health/capacity/revision → inner codec lexical/resources/structure in frozen order → unsupported projection → dependency completeness/freshness → plan revalidation → reserve/IO → receipt proof → ACK. Never decode document before caller authorization. Same-request completed replay requires same authorized binding; revoked callers cannot retrieve old proof.
dto_errors.codec_details: ResourceLimit includes token,limit,observed,path; root path /; Syntax includes byte_offset (UTF8 original input) and reason invalid_token|unclosed|duplicate_attribute|invalid_character. ForbiddenFeature reason dtd|entity|namespace|processing_instruction. Structure reason missing_section|duplicate_section|invalid_root. Do not leak raw source content in messages.
dto_errors.retry: No automatic IO retry, repair or write-on-timeout. Timeout/owner loss during IO retains reservation until actual completion; show pending proof query. New request never bypasses prior uncertain target.
dto_errors.storage_passthrough: Preserve InvalidPath.reason; AlreadyExists.path; Busy.path; Conflict.expected/observed; Storage.stage/path/reason; RecoveryRequired.target_path/journal_path/old_version_path/new_version_path/reason. UI message is projection, diagnostic retains structured original.

commands_ui.common: All mutating DTOs deny unknown fields. IDs opaque ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; expected_revision u64. No project_root/path/digest authority from UI. Binding token checked against actual Tauri window instance, not label alone. Main Editor only; Viewer cannot call these commands.
commands_ui.response: Tagged Result {ok:{kind,payload}}|{error:DocumentError}. Projection {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_uuid,generation,revision,format,semantic_profile,dirty,can_mutate,health,pending_binding_ids,blocked_capabilities}; no mutable S1 handle exposed.
commands_ui.raw_ingress: Outer Tauri JSON already decoded: no guarantee outer duplicates/size-before-allocation. Only inner source_text/design_json guarded before typed decode. Bad payload never invokes S1 commit.
commands_ui.migration: Existing scene_save/scene_load text routes and design typed save/load/build fail closed DOCUMENT_OWNER_REQUIRED or DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED; no fallback to direct FS. M03 facade submits design mutation into same owner using inner raw JSON. Remove JS confirmLeaveSceneIfDirty authority and retainUiExclusiveNodes/clamp normalization from persistence path; UI uses projection and separate explicit edit.

ui_schema.DocumentPanel: Open/Save/SaveAs/Undo/Clear/Close controls; revision and health shown; mutation disabled unless current writer+Healthy. Clear preview exact section counts/paths, confirm/cancel, expired preview requests refresh.
ui_schema.errors: Inline structured error summary, pending save proof query, no success toast on deferred ACK; preserve unsaved text on rejection.
ui_schema.accessibility: Keyboard controls; focus stays on failed action; status aria-live polite; blocked actions explanation accessible.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
